name: Buxar Bihar
summary:
Credit professional with 3+ years of experience in secured lending, mortgage underwriting and credit risk management across Banking
and Housing Finance. Currently working as Cluster Credit Manager – Credit at Hinduja Housing Finance, with hands-on exposure to
Home Loan and LAP credit assessment. Strong understanding of financial and banking analysis, bureau assessment, FOIR/LTV,
repayment capacity, property and collateral assessment, FI/FCU, legal & technical evaluation and credit appraisal. Experienced in
risk-based credit decisioning while maintaining policy adherence, portfolio quality and defined TAT/SLA.
EDUCATION: 1. B.A. — Chhatrapati Sahu Ji Maharaj University (2019 - 2022) [conf 0.95, review=False]

responsibilities: Handle end-to-end credit underwriting and appraisal of Home Loan & LAP proposals in line with defined credit policy and risk parameters.
Evaluate borrower creditworthiness, income stability, banking conduct, bureau profile and repayment capacity to arrive at sound credit decisions.
Analyse FOIR, LTV, ITRs, bank statements, income documents and financial profiles for salaried and self-employed customers.
Review FI/FCU findings, Personal Discussion, KYC and customer profile to identify potential credit, fraud and repayment risks.
Assess property and collateral-related risks in coordination with Legal and Technical teams and review relevant observations.
Prepare and review CAM/credit appraisal notes, clearly highlighting strengths, risks, mitigants, deviations and credit recommendations.
Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Legal, Technical and Verification teams for timely query resolution and achievement of defined TAT/SLA.
Ensure adherence to credit policy, underwriting guidelines, internal controls and applicable regulatory requirements.
Support risk-aligned business growth while maintaining portfolio quality and sound underwriting standards.
Conducted underwriting of mortgage applications by analysing income documents, bank statements, credit scores and business profiles.
Performed cash-flow assessment, ratio analysis, repayment capacity assessment and risk profiling for credit decisioning.
Prepared detailed credit appraisal reports with clear justification and recommendations for approval/rejection.
Ensured adherence to internal credit policies, regulatory requirements and risk-management frameworks.
Coordinated with Sales, Operations and Product teams to streamline credit processes and improve turnaround time.
Monitored portfolio quality and identified potential risk triggers, supporting appropriate corrective and mitigation actions.
